ac_evidence.ac: Hook fires when Cursor agent finishes a response
If pr_number is set AND (last_phase != ci OR last_state != ok): exit 2 (block)
Block message: CI phase incomplete. Run: sdp ci-loop --pr {N} --feature F{NNN}
If no active checkpoint OR CI phase complete: exit 0 (allow)
Handles stop_hook_active flag to prevent infinite loops
Test: agent tries to stop before CI → blocked; agent stops after CI green → allowed
